name: Colosseum
summary: The Roman Colosseum with arena show, crowd and surroundings as a Blender 5.3 scene (665 objects), with procedural MaterialCraft textures and their source package.
notes: Release-only: built in Blender with MaterialCraft materials and no imported third-party assets; the owner set the license and credit (2026-11-14). Textures load from textures/ next to Colosseum.blend.
